name: Rustwater
description: An orange dwarf presiding over red deserts and a single scarred rock with a captured moon. The inner world bakes while the outer one freezes, and the dwarf planet between them confuses every formation model. Water claims drive the only politics here.

stars.name: Rustwater Ember
stars.description: A long-lived orange dwarf with a gentle light the colonists praise in every charter. Its habitable zone sits close and stable, undisturbed for billions of years. Flare activity is negligible and getting weaker.

planets.name: Coppersand
planets.description: A dune-covered desert where copper salts tint every erg green and blue. Deep aquifers sustain a string of oasis towns along the equator. Sandstorms can bury a crawler in a single night.

planets.name: Redscar
planets.description: A rusted rock pocked by an ancient basin that nearly broke it. Iron mines follow the basin rim where the impact exposed the mantle. A single captured moon keeps the only reliable calendar.

moons.name: Scarkeep
moons.description: A dark captured rock in a slow retrograde orbit, likely snagged from the outer belt. Its carbonaceous bulk supplies volatiles the inner worlds lack. Tugs visit on a strict fuel-margin schedule.

dwarfPlanets.name: Halfmeasure
dwarfPlanets.description: A small hybrid world that fits no formation story, half ice and half rock in alternating bands. Its density varies by hemisphere in a way that bothers the modelers. Sample returns keep getting funded despite the confusion.
